basic_details.post_name: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) & Project Manager - Venture Growth & Impact

age_limit.details: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – TEJAS: Maximum age limit is 55 years. Project Manager - Venture Growth & Impact: Maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates will be as per Central Government rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in Management, Engineering, Technology or Science with good academic record for CEO. Master's degree in Management, Engineering or Technology for Project Manager.
qualification.details: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – TEJAS Master's degree in Management, Engineering, Technology or Science, or an equivalent professional qualification, with a consistently good academic record, from a recognised University/Institution. A doctoral degree in a relevant discipline shall be an added advantage. Minimum 15 years of post-qualification professional experience, of which at least 05 years shall have been in a senior leadership or head-of-function position. Demonstrated experience in at least two of the following areas: (i) leading an incubator, accelerator or technology business incubator; (ii) venture capital, angel investment or startup funding; (iii) mobilisation of funds through CSR, grants, philanthropy or industry partnerships; (iv) building and leading an innovation or entrepreneurship ecosystem; (v) founding and scaling an enterprise. Proven record of institutional relationship-building with corporates, government bodies and investors. Project Manager - Venture Growth & Impact Master's degree in Management, Engineering or Technology, or an equivalent qualification, from a recognised University/Institution. Minimum 08 years of post-qualification professional experience, of which at least 03 years shall have been in incubation or acceleration, venture building, startup advisory, venture capital or investment, or in founding and operating a startup. Demonstrated exposure to business model validation, MVP development, customer acquisition and funding readiness. Proficiency in tracking venture milestones and preparing performance and impact reports.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIM Mumbai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Mumbai recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIM Mumbai recruitment is 08 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which IIM Mumbai is recruiting?
faq.answer: IIM Mumbai is recruiting for two posts: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – TEJAS and Project Manager - Venture Growth & Impact.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the CEO position?
faq.answer: For the CEO position, a Master's degree in Management, Engineering, Technology or Science, or an equivalent professional qualification, with a consistently good academic record, is required. A doctoral degree is an added advantage.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Manager - Venture Growth & Impact position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the CEO role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) position is Rs. 43 Lakh Per Annum.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply by sending their detailed application along with supporting documents via email to the specified address, with the subject line indicating the post applied for.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, no application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced by IIM Mumbai for these positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the type of job contract?
faq.answer: These positions are offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. What are the key selection stages for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Skill/Competency Test, Personal Interview, and other modes of assessment.
